after.objective: Verify Game Over priority when player HP and the living-enemy count both reach zero in one frame.
after.initial_state: State is playing. Player HP = 1 with no damage invulnerability, and the last enemy has 1 HP. A player bullet will hit that enemy while an already active enemy bullet will hit the player in the same update.
after.trigger: Advance the complete update through bullet collisions, enemy death, player damage, and terminal resolution.
after.expected_transition: HP = 0 and Enemies = 0 after damage processing; the final state is game_over, which takes priority over victory.
after.detection_method: Controlled simultaneous damage with before/after state snapshots

after.expected_transition: The chest becomes opened and the final treasure is obtained, but HP = 0 makes the final state game_over; victory does not override Game Over.
